meta.name: adversarial-debate-truthseeking
meta.description: Strategy: Dialectic engine retuned for truth-seeking, not survival. A defender steelmans a claim into its MOST falsifiable form, a critic attacks to refute it, a judge classifies the exchange into BROKEN/CORROBORATED/UNFALSIFIABLE — the judge does NOT pick a winner or score persuasiveness. Methods: Irving debate (repurposed), Toulmin argumentation, Mayo severe testing.

copy.tagline: 用辩论框架检验观点真伪
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要严谨地检验一个主张是否站得住脚。
copy.tagline_en: Test claims for truth using structured debate
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to rigorously test whether a claim holds up.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会针对你的主张启动一场真理寻求辩论：辩护者将主张改写为最可反驳的形式，批评者找出具体反驳点，裁判将结果分类为被推翻、被证实或不可检验。
howto.when: 当你提出一个需要检验的主张或假设时，技能会主动启动辩论流程。

say.text: 请对这个主张进行真理寻求式辩论
say.note: 启动流程后Claude会扮演三个角色

say.text: 扮演辩护者，把此主张改写为最可反驳的形式
say.note: 要求Claude先执行辩护者职责

say.text: 扮演批评者，找出一个能反驳它的具体例子

howto.what_en: Claude runs a truth-seeking debate on your claim: a defender restates the claim in its most falsifiable form, a critic attacks with a concrete refuter, and a judge classifies the result as BROKEN/CORROBORATED/UNFALSIFIABLE.
howto.when_en: When you present a claim or hypothesis that needs testing, the skill triggers the debate process.

say_en.text: Run a truth-seeking debate on this claim
Act as defender, restate the claim in its most falsifiable form
Act as critic, find a concrete counterexample
